Title: Currency Rounding 001 & To Zero
Preconditions: Admin logged in; USD currency; AGENT-TEST- Product_1 created with list price $26.25 and an AGENT-TEST- 5% item promotion applied to it (the discounted unit price 26.25 x 0.95 = 24.9375 is not a midpoint, so the rounding MODE decides the cent)
Test_Data: {{BACK_URL}} {{ADMIN_EMAIL}} {{ADMIN_PASSWORD}} {{STORE_ID}} {{FRONT_URL}}; product=AGENT-TEST-Product-<random>; price=26.25; promotion=AGENT-TEST-Promo-<random> 5% item discount; qty=3
Steps:
[NAV] Go to Store > Default currency > Currencies > USD > set RoundingType = Rounding001, Midpoint rounding = ToZero (Admin label; ToZero is .NET directed rounding toward zero, not midpoint-only)
[ACT] Save
[ACT] Add Product_1 (list price $26.25, 5% promotion) to cart
[ACT] Set quantity to 3
[ASSERT] Verify pricing (xAPI cart and storefront)
Assertions:
[STATE] Rounding settings saved
[MATH] Unit price after the 5% promotion = 24.93 (24.9375 rounded toward zero, NOT 24.94)
[MATH] Line total = 74.82 (observed; it is not unit x qty, since 24.93 x 3 = 74.79)

[API] xAPI cart returns unit 24.93 and line total 74.82 with ToZero rounding applied
[CONSOLE] No pricing calculation errors

References: C307019; Repaired 2026-10-13 (Stable 16 regression VCST-6042): ToZero is .NET directed rounding toward zero (26.25 x 0.95 = 24.9375 -> 24.93), not midpoint-only, so 24.94 was a wrong expectation; the Admin label "Midpoint rounding" is misleading and VirtoOZ does not document the rounding modes (doc gap, values are {OBSERVED})
